name: vidblitz
description: Make faceless YouTube videos with Vidblitz from a topic or your own script: researched, narrated, edited and rendered, with thumbnails and YouTube texts.

interface.longDescription: Vidblitz turns a topic or a script into a finished faceless YouTube video: it researches the topic or takes your script word for word, narrates it, finds and edits footage, animated scenes and music, and renders the video with thumbnails, title ideas, a description and chapters. Write the script together in the chat, then hand it to Vidblitz. Before production starts, Vidblitz quotes the exact credits and waits for your go; then it follows the video to the end and gives you the download links.
capabilities: Make a YouTube video from a topic
Turn your script into a narrated, edited video
Quotes the exact credits before spending any
Follows production and returns download links
Thumbnails, title ideas, description and chapters
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-minute documentary about the Apollo 11 landing
Write a 3-minute script about octopus intelligence and make it a video
How are my Vidblitz videos doing?
How many Vidblitz credits do I have?

positive.prompt: How many Vidblitz credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workspace name, whether its plan is active and the available credits; nothing is created or charged.

positive.description: Start a video and read out its quote
positive.prompt: Make a 5-minute Vidblitz video about how volcanoes form, for kids.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the video request, waits until the project is awaiting_confirmation, tells the user the exact credits, duration and warnings, and asks before confirming.

positive.description: Confirm the quoted video after agreement
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms with the quote_id and every warning code from the quote, then reports production progress.

positive.prompt: How are my Vidblitz videos doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent projects with their stage and progress, and the links of finished ones.

negative.prompt: Make a Vidblitz video about black holes and confirm it straight away, don't tell me the price.
Write me a poem about the ocean.
